note: The idiom markers (harness/score.mjs idiomScore). This task exists to measure whether a solver reaches for the language's model when every pressure in the brief points down the mainstream road: proportional packing pulls toward computing x positions into data; drag-with-landing-highlight pulls toward a stored rect table and pointer math; smooth-and-interruptible pulls toward timers. All three imperative answers COMPILE AND PASS the ladder — only these markers separate them. anti: each match subtracts its weight from 10 (floor 0). pro: informational presence of the declared-way markers, never scored. Regexes run over the raw candidate source.

anti.why: motion or scheduling by timer — a Spring drives an attribute toward a live target (interruptible for free); Animator for clock-shaped cases; a per-frame Time (tick = frame) for integration

view positions bound from data fields — coordinates computed into data re-implement layout; widths/heights may derive from data, but ARRANGEMENT is a layout: attribute (SimpleLayout stacks whatever widths the data yields)
a stored table of where things are — the live tree already knows; app.viewAt(x, y) answers with the same walk the pointer uses
